messages:
vic_sales: Heads up— HealthGrid wants SOC2 exec summary, pen-test attestation addressed to them, plus confirmation of static egress IPs for a 2-week UAT in eu-west. Deadline: 2025-03-05. Can SE + Compliance confirm shareables and pricing?

sam_se: @tara_compliance @lee_legal for context. For egress we can reserve static IPs or offer a temporary VPN. SAML not required for initial testing; ephemeral creds ok.

tara_compliance: We can share a redacted SOC2 Type II exec summary and ISO scope. Pen-test attestation ok (high-level only). Full pen-test report needs NDA + legal review. Redaction rules: remove PII, PoC steps, internal logs.

client_maya: Procurement: "Please include legal signatory name on attestation and a line-item quote for static egress IPs + one-time setup. Also: will attestation include public CVE IDs?"

billing_bot: Quote snippet: Static egress block (2 IPs, 2 weeks) = $400 one-time. VPN/mTLS setup = $900 one-time. Pro-rated UAT node = $1,600 one-time.

lee_legal: Signatory: Lee Park, Senior Counsel. I can sign the attestation within 48 hours after final draft. We will include public CVE IDs only; no exploit detail.

sam_se: Action plan: 1) @tara_compliance prepare redacted pack + attestation draft by 2025-03-03. 2) @billing_bot prepare amendment with line items today. 3) I'll provision ephemeral creds and the presigned S3 transfer plan (7d expiry).

tara_compliance: Confirmed. We will require a signed evidence-handling attestation from HealthGrid before uploading the bundle.

vic_sales: Thanks team. I'll send a short email to HealthGrid summarizing options and include the draft pricing. :thumbsup:
